title: twin over queen bunk bed
text: twin over queen bunk bed. We needed an adult spot with possible youngster up top.  This is perfect... Took husband and 7 year old grandson about 2 hours to put together.  It is a little "industrial" with the black tubing... but everyone seems happy.  Watch your mattress thickness for the top bunk or you will negate the safety bars... It is very stable... read other reviews that suggested it might be wobbly... we have not found that to be true.  Was a fair price and everyone is happy.
